children: Revelation Biosciences reported a net loss of $3.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, and a net loss of $9.6 million for the first nine months of the year. The company had $9.1 million in cash and cash equivalents at quarter-end and said its cash was expected to fund operations into the second quarter of 2027.

Operating expenses were $3.4 million for the third quarter of 2026, compared with $1.9 million in the same quarter of 2025. For the first nine months, operating expenses were $10.1 million, compared with $6.5 million.
Loss from operations was $3.4 million for the third quarter and $10.1 million for the first nine months of 2026.
Net loss was $3.3 million for the third quarter of 2026, compared with $1.9 million in the prior-year quarter. For the first nine months, net loss was $9.6 million, compared with $6.4 million.
Basic and diluted net loss per share was $5.92 for the third quarter and $29.37 for the first nine months of 2026.
Cash and cash equivalents totaled $9.1 million as of September 30, 2026. Net cash used in operating activities was $2.6 million in the third quarter.
An independent market assessment indicated a potential $94 billion total addressable market for Gemini.
Revelation selected a full-service contract research organization with global operations for its upcoming study evaluating Gemini in patients with acute kidney injury.
The company is developing Gemini for acute kidney injury, chronic kidney disease, severe-burn-related hyperinflammation and infection, and prevention of post-surgical infection.
